title: Same user function called from two concurrent-assign sites — Tier 4.3 pass-13 fence
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Two concurrent assigns `y1 <= invert(a); y2 <= invert(b);` share the same user function. Regression fence for pass-13's shared-CachedScope contract: FunctionExecutor.ExecuteFunction reuses function.CachedScope across the two calls, RefreshScopeArgs rebinds parameter values in-place before each body execution, and DeltaCycleEngine runs Operations serially within a delta cycle so the two writes don't cross-contaminate. Synth-time BeginInline/EndInline (SynthesisContext.cs) is name-scoped and cleared between calls — two independent cell chains render, sharing input nets a/b. Any future refactor that makes fn execution async or concurrent within a delta would race on the shared CachedScope; this fence catches that.
